results.rationale: Consistency: The tiled floor, two loose stones, room framing and outer wall edges are preserved. A broad area of previously intact rough wall outside the hole is replaced by smooth rectangular blocks, changing a clear non-target surface. Instruction: The large opening is fully closed with a continuous masonry surface and no exposed white gap remains. Quality: The block joints, surface shading and floor perspective are coherent; the completed wall has no obvious gaps, ghosting or distorted geometry.

Consistency: The central lantern retains its silhouette, red panels, gold decorative ribs, suspension cord and tassel. The new background, foliage, petals and glow are explicitly requested and are not penalized. Instruction: The festive red-gold background, golden foliage, petals, sparkles and centered lantern are present. However, the exact Welcoming Spring Festival headline is missing, and a merged New Year/in Lights message lies across the lantern rather than providing separate top and bottom text. Quality: The lantern and decorations are coherent, but overlapping gold script and gold ornamentation create a conspicuous tangled, difficult-to-read text area.
